settings.name: OIDF_SSF_ISSUER
settings.description: The transmitter's issuer: the SETs' iss and the base of every endpoint it advertises, so the external base receivers use; unset, SSF is off (unless OIDF_SSF_ENABLED=true) and PingFederate starts regardless

when_wrong.detail: Unset: SSF is off (DISABLED). With OIDF_SSF_ENABLED=true it is FAILED_CONFIG, with an ERROR naming this setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_SIGNING_ALGORITHM
settings.description: How the transmitter signs its SETs

when_wrong.detail: Anything but RS256 or PS256 (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_BASE_PATH
settings.description: The path after the issuer in the endpoints the transmitter advertises; the servlets serve /ssf whatever it says

when_wrong.detail: Anything but /ssf advertises endpoints nothing serves

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_DATA_STORE_ID
settings.description: A PingFederate JDBC data store, on PostgreSQL, whose pool the SSF store uses; with neither this nor a JDBC URL the store is in memory, lost at a restart and seen by one node only, which production allows only with the in-memory-state risk accepted

when_wrong.detail: An unknown id, or its database down: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause. A database that is not PostgreSQL is refused in production (REFUSED)

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_STORE_DIALECT
settings.description: The SSF store's layout: tables, its own three ssf_ tables, or ldm, the Identity Object Model's entry store; only read with a data store or a JDBC URL

when_wrong.detail: Anything but tables or ldm (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_JDBC_URL
settings.description: A direct database for the SSF store, for development; wins over the data store. jdbc:h2: and jdbc:hsqldb: are refused, and in production anything but jdbc:postgresql:

when_wrong.detail: A database that cannot be opened: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause; the ERROR shows <jdbcUrl> for the URL. A URL that is not jdbc:postgresql: is refused in production (REFUSED)

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_JDBC_USERNAME
settings.description: The user for the direct database

when_wrong.detail: As the JDBC URL, the store does not open: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_JDBC_PASSWORD
settings.description: The password for the direct database

when_wrong.detail: As the JDBC URL, the store does not open: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether every SET is also published to Kafka; off, no Kafka class is loaded

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it; true without the bootstrap servers is FAILED_CONFIG too

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS
settings.description: The Kafka brokers, host:port comma-separated; required with Kafka on

when_wrong.detail: Unset with Kafka on: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_TOPIC
settings.description: The Kafka topic SETs are published to

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
settings.description: Kafka's security.protocol; PLAINTEXT, the default, is the value PR-2 forbids in production

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_MECHANISM
settings.description: Kafka's sasl.mechanism when the protocol is a SASL one; PLAIN when unset

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_USERNAME
settings.description: The SASL user for Kafka

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD
settings.description: The SASL password for Kafka

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_PUSH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS
settings.description: How many failed pushes of one SET a push stream takes before it is paused as dead-lettered; 1 or less pauses it on the first failed push

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_PUSH_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS
settings.description: The background loop's tick, and the base of the push retry's doubling backoff; below 1 means 1

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_POLL_MAX_EVENTS
settings.description: The most SETs a poll answers when the receiver asks for no number, and the most the receiver's own poll asks for (100 when this is 0 or less)

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_SET_TTL_SECONDS
settings.description: How long an undelivered SET is kept before it is deleted; 0 or less keeps it for ever

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_SCOPE
settings.description: The scope a bearer token needs for the stream management API and the poll

when_wrong.detail: A scope no client holds: every call is a 403

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_UNOWNED_STREAM_OWNER
settings.description: The one client admitted to streams that record no owner; unset, nobody is

when_wrong.detail: An id that names no client admits nobody

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_PROVISIONER_SCOPE
settings.description: The scope that admits a client to the SCIM endpoint and events:emit; unset, nobody is. Never the receiver scope

when_wrong.detail: The receiver scope: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming both settings

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_ALLOWED_AUDIENCES
settings.description: The aud values a client may name when it creates a stream besides its own id, as clientA=aud1,aud2;clientB=aud3

when_wrong.detail: An entry that is not clientId=aud[,aud]: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT
settings.description: Where receivers' and provisioners' bearer tokens are introspected (RFC 7662), through platform's TokenIntrospector: 1 s to connect, 2.5 s in all, and no answer is a 503; <issuer>/as/introspect.oauth2 when unset. An active answer is also held to its exp and nbf, to aud containing OIDF_SSF_ISSUER when it carries an aud, and to carrying a client_id; a token bound to a key or certificate (cnf) is refused, because the SSF endpoints take bearer tokens only

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. A URL that is not an introspection endpoint: every authenticated call is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: The client that introspects receivers' tokens; unset, no receiver can authenticate

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: every authenticated call is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: The introspecting client's secret

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: every authenticated call is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_INSECURE_TLS
settings.description: Trusts any certificate on the introspection call, through platform's InsecureTls; the host name is still checked

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_DEFAULT_EVENT_TYPES
settings.description: The event types the transmitter advertises as events_supported, comma-separated; the five CAEP and RISC types it emits when unset

when_wrong.detail: Taken as written, split at commas and blanks; set to nothing but separators: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_DEFAULT_SUBJECTS
settings.description: What a stream hears before any subject is added to it: NONE, or ALL, every subject (SSF 1.0 7.1.1)

when_wrong.detail: Anything but ALL or NONE (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_VERIFICATION_EVENT_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether a receiver may ask for a verification event

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_EXPECTED_ISSUER
settings.description: The transmitter whose SETs this PingFederate accepts; set, the receiver is on (unless OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_ENABLED=false)

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: every SET is refused

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_JWKS_URL
settings.description: The JWKS inbound SETs are verified against; <receiverExpectedIssuer>/pf/JWKS when unset

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The wrong JWKS: every SET is refused

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_AUDIENCE
settings.description: The aud an inbound SET must carry; required with the receiver on

when_wrong.detail: Unset with the receiver on: SSF_RECEIVER is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoint answers 503, with an ERROR naming it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_ENDPOINT_AUTH_TOKEN
settings.description: The bearer token a transmitter must present to push to this receiver; required with the receiver on

when_wrong.detail: Unset with the receiver on: SSF_RECEIVER is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoint answers 503, with an ERROR naming it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_JWKS_CACHE_SECONDS
settings.description: How long the receiver keeps the transmitter's JWKS; 0 or less fetches it for each SET

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_INSECURE_TLS
settings.description: Trusts any certificate on the receiver's JWKS fetch, poll and stream calls, through platform's InsecureTls; the host name is still checked

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_URL
settings.description: A transmitter's poll endpoint to pull SETs from; unset, the receiver takes pushes only

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The wrong endpoint: each poll fails and is logged

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_TOKEN
settings.description: The bearer token the receiver's poll presents

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: each poll fails and is logged

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
settings.description: How often the receiver polls; below 1 means 1

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_ACTIONS_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether an inbound revocation signal acts on PingFederate, revoking the subject's grants

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_INSTANCE_REGISTRY
settings.description: Whether inbound CAEP signals act on the agent instance registry; needs the ldm store, and is refused with a warning on any other

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_AUDIT_EVENTS_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether PingFederate's security audit events are turned into SETs

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_AUDIT_EVENT_MAP
settings.description: EVENT=action pairs, comma-separated, that extend or override which audit events become which SETs

when_wrong.detail: Taken as written
